scripts.build: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/postgres && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run build -w @hall/client && npm run build -w @hall/desktop
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/postgres && npm test -w @hall/server
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:coverage -w @hall/server && npm run test:coverage -w @hall/domain
scripts.test:ballot: npm test -w @hall/domain -- --run src/state-machines/ballotSafety.test.ts src/schemas.test.ts && npm test -w @hall/server -- --run src/__tests__/ballotConcurrency.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/templating && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/postgres && npm run build -w @hall/server && concurrently -k -n client,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hall/client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env HALL_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 npm run start -w @hall/desktop"
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run package -w @hall/desktop
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run make -w @hall/desktop
scripts.e2e:server: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run start -w @hall/server
scripts.check:architecture: node scripts/check-exhaustive-dispatch.mjs && npm run test:architecture && code-moniker check .
scripts.lint: biome check packages/*/src packages/*/*.ts packages/desktop/scripts packages/client/e2e packages/client/scripts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages/*/src packages/*/*.ts packages/desktop/scripts packages/client/e2e packages/client/scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run typecheck -w @hall/postgres && npm run typecheck -w @hall/server && npm run typecheck -w @hall/client && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run typecheck -w @hall/desktop
scripts.quality: npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.quality:e2e: npm run quality && npm run test:e2e
